consequence.statement: Resources of the listed kinds are excluded from Argo CD by default, so they are no longer tracked or managed unless resource.exclusions is overridden or removed in the configMap.
consequence.remediation: Override or remove resource.exclusions in argocd-cm to preserve v2 behavior.

original.statement: The Argo CD manifest now ships a default resource.exclusions in argocd-cm that excludes high-churn controller-created kinds (Endpoints, EndpointSlice, Lease, Kyverno reports, Cilium identities, etc.); it can be overridden or removed to preserve v2 behavior.

decision.reason: [ev-3437aa882db2] says the Argo CD manifest now ships a default `resource.exclusions` in argocd-cm that excludes the listed high-churn kinds for performance reasons. It also says these defaults can be overridden or removed to restore the v2 behaviour. That is a changed default, and the evidence does not say anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so behavior-change (review) fits. The statement that these kinds are no longer tracked unless the exclusions are overridden matches the excerpt, and so does the remediation.
